models.name: audit_report
models.description: Independent Auditor's Report disclosures: Accounting Firm (KAP), Signing Partner, Audit Opinion, and Key Audit Matters (KAM).

columns.name: issuer_id
columns.description: IDX ticker symbol.

columns.name: fiscal_year
columns.description: Audited fiscal year.

columns.name: audit_firm
columns.description: Public Accounting Firm name (Kantor Akuntan Publik / KAP).

columns.name: network
columns.description: Global accounting network affiliation (Big 4: PwC, EY, Deloitte, KPMG, or BDO, etc.).

columns.name: signing_partner
columns.description: Name of the signing Certified Public Accountant (CPA).

columns.name: opinion
columns.description: Auditor opinion: Unqualified (Wajar Tanpa Pengecualian / WTP), Qualified, Adverse, Disclaimer.

columns.name: key_audit_matters
columns.description: Titles or descriptions of Key Audit Matters (Hal Audit Utama) identified by the auditor.

columns.name: source_page
columns.description: PDF page number of the Independent Auditor's Report.

models.name: commodity_trend_monthly
models.description: Monthly aggregated commodity benchmark prices, physical spot assessments, and proxies. Includes Gold (GC=F), WTI Crude (CL=F), Brent Crude (BZ=F), Anhydrous Ammonia Spot Benchmark (NH3=F in USD/ton), and Ammonia proxies (ESSA.JK, CF, UAN, NG=F).

columns.name: symbol
columns.description: Commodity symbol: GC=F (Gold), CL=F (WTI Oil), BZ=F (Brent Oil), NH3=F (Anhydrous Ammonia Spot Benchmark in USD/ton), ESSA.JK (Domestic Ammonia producer), CF (Global Ammonia producer), UAN (Ammonia Fertilizer proxy), NG=F (Natural Gas feedgas).

columns.name: commodity_name
columns.description: Full descriptive name of the commodity benchmark or proxy.

columns.name: commodity_category
columns.description: Category: PRECIOUS_METALS, ENERGY, CHEMICALS_FERTILIZERS.

columns.name: month_date
columns.description: First day of the calendar month (e.g. 2025-01-01).

columns.name: avg_close
columns.description: Average closing price across all trading days in the month.

columns.name: min_close
columns.description: Minimum daily close during the month.

columns.name: max_close
columns.description: Maximum daily close during the month.

columns.name: end_month_close
columns.description: Final trading day closing price of the month.

columns.name: monthly_return_pct
columns.description: Monthly percentage price return ((last_close - first_close) / first_close * 100).

columns.name: unit
columns.description: Trading unit: USD/ton, USD/troy oz, USD/bbl, USD/MMBtu, IDR/share, USD/share.

models.name: financial_summary
models.description: Standardized cross-industry financial statement summary for Indonesian public companies (IDX) under IFRS and PSAK. Contains face balance sheet, income statement, and cash flow items.

columns.name: issuer_id
columns.description: 4-character IDX stock ticker symbol (e.g. BBCA, NCKL, ADRO, MAPI, ARCI, BREN, ESSA).

columns.name: period_end
columns.description: Financial reporting period end date (e.g. 2025-12-31).

columns.name: fiscal_year
columns.description: Fiscal year (e.g. 2024, 2025).

columns.name: fiscal_period
columns.description: Reporting period code: FY (Full Year annual audited), Q1 (First Quarter), H1 (First Half), 9M (Nine Months).

columns.name: currency
columns.description: Reporting currency: IDR (Indonesian Rupiah) or USD (US Dollar). Always check currency before aggregating.

columns.name: total_assets
columns.description: Total assets as reported on the statement of financial position. In full nominal currency units.

columns.name: current_assets
columns.description: Total current assets. For commercial banks (e.g. BBCA, BBSI) presenting in order of liquidity, this field is NULL.

columns.name: total_liabilities
columns.description: Total liabilities in full nominal currency units.

columns.name: current_liabilities
columns.description: Total current liabilities. NULL for commercial banks presenting in order of liquidity.

columns.name: total_equity
columns.description: Total equity attributable to owners and non-controlling interests.

columns.name: temporary_syirkah_funds
columns.description: Dana Syirkah Temporer under PSAK 101 for Islamic institutions and commercial banks with sharia subsidiaries (e.g. BBCA / BCA Syariah). Situated between liabilities and equity. Assets = Liabilities + Equity + Syirkah Funds.

columns.name: revenue
columns.description: Top-line gross operating revenue. For corporate entities, this is gross sales/contracts; for commercial banks, this coalesces interest income and operating income.

columns.name: cost_of_revenue
columns.description: Cost of goods sold (COGS) or banking interest expense (cost of funds).

columns.name: gross_profit
columns.description: Gross profit for corporate entities, or Net Interest Income (Interest Income - Interest Expense) for commercial banks.

columns.name: net_profit
columns.description: Bottom-line net profit for the year/period (Laba tahun berjalan) attributable to the entity.

columns.name: operating_cash_flow
columns.description: Net cash flows generated from operating activities (Direct method).

columns.name: capex
columns.description: Capital expenditures (Acquisition of Property, Plant & Equipment, Bearer Plants, or Intangible Assets from cash flows). Expressed as a positive nominal magnitude.

columns.name: bank_loans
columns.description: Gross loan portfolio (Kredit yang diberikan) for commercial banks (BBCA, BBSI).

columns.name: bank_deposits
columns.description: Customer deposits (Dana Pihak Ketiga: Giro, Tabungan, Deposito) for commercial banks.

columns.name: return_on_equity_pct
columns.description: Return on Equity (ROE) percentage.

columns.name: return_on_assets_pct
columns.description: Return on Assets (ROA) percentage.

columns.name: net_profit_margin_pct
columns.description: Net Profit Margin percentage.

columns.name: gross_profit_margin_pct
columns.description: Gross Profit Margin percentage (or Net Interest Margin proxy for banks).

columns.name: debt_to_equity_ratio
columns.description: Debt to Equity Ratio (Total Liabilities / Total Equity).

columns.name: current_ratio
columns.description: Current Ratio (Current Assets / Current Liabilities). Applicable only to non-bank entities.

columns.name: loan_to_deposit_ratio_pct
columns.description: Loan to Deposit Ratio (LDR) for commercial banks.

models.name: financial_summary_provenance
models.description: Audit trail mapping every metric in financial_summary to its exact source PDF page citation (e.g. p.4, p.18).

columns.name: issuer_id
columns.description: IDX ticker symbol.

columns.name: period_end
columns.description: Filing period cut-off date.

columns.name: fiscal_year
columns.description: Fiscal year.

columns.name: total_assets_page
columns.description: PDF page citation for Total Assets (e.g. 'p.4').

columns.name: revenue_page
columns.description: PDF page citation for Revenue (e.g. 'p.18').

columns.name: net_profit_page
columns.description: PDF page citation for Net Profit (e.g. 'p.18').

columns.name: operating_cash_flow_page
columns.description: PDF page citation for Operating Cash Flow (e.g. 'p.24').

columns.name: capex_page
columns.description: PDF page citation for Capex (e.g. 'p.25').

models.name: market_valuation
models.description: Cross-asset valuation view linking fundamental financial statements with historical stock prices, latest closing market prices, and price returns since filing period end.

columns.name: issuer_id
columns.description: IDX stock ticker (e.g. ADRO, BBCA, NCKL, ARCI, ESSA).

columns.name: fiscal_year
columns.description: Fiscal year of the filing.

columns.name: fiscal_period
columns.description: Fiscal period (FY, Q1, H1, 9M).

columns.name: period_end
columns.description: Filing period cut-off date.

columns.name: currency
columns.description: Financial statement currency.

columns.name: revenue
columns.description: Reported revenue in nominal units.

columns.name: net_profit
columns.description: Reported net profit in nominal units.

columns.name: total_equity
columns.description: Reported book value of equity.

columns.name: period_close_price
columns.description: Stock closing price on or closest to the filing period end date (in IDR/share).

columns.name: latest_close_price
columns.description: Most recent trading day closing price (in IDR/share).

columns.name: price_change_since_period_pct
columns.description: Percentage return of the stock price from the period close date to the latest market date.

models.name: officer_position
models.description: Board of Directors (Direksi) and Board of Commissioners (Dewan Komisaris) profiles extracted from Annual Report corporate governance chapters.

columns.name: issuer_id
columns.description: IDX stock ticker symbol.

columns.name: person_name
columns.description: Full legal name and titles of the officer or board member.

columns.name: role
columns.description: Official title (e.g. Direktur Utama, Komisaris Utama, Komisaris Independen, Direktur Keuangan).

columns.name: is_independent
columns.description: True if the commissioner is officially designated as Independent Commissioner (Komisaris Independen).

columns.name: source_page
columns.description: PDF page number where the governance profile was published.

models.name: operational_kpi
models.description: Operational Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) extracted from Annual Reports and Financial Statement disclosures: Production Volumes, Sales Volumes, Installed Capacities, and Utilization across Petrochemicals (Ammonia, LPG, Condensate), Mining (Nickel, Coal, Gold), Agriculture (CPO, TBS), and Infrastructure.

columns.name: fact_id
columns.description: Unique SHA-256 identifier for the fact.

columns.name: issuer_id
columns.description: IDX stock ticker symbol (e.g. ESSA, NCKL, ADRO, LSIP, ARCI).

columns.name: fiscal_year
columns.description: Fiscal reporting year (e.g. 2023, 2024, 2025).

columns.name: fiscal_period
columns.description: Reporting period code (FY, Q1, H1, 9M).

columns.name: concept_id
columns.description: Standardized operational concept ID (e.g. op.core.production_volume, op.core.sales_volume, op.core.installed_capacity).

columns.name: label_raw
columns.description: Original disclosure line-item label from filing (e.g. Produksi Amoniak, Penjualan Amoniak, Produksi Elpiji, Produksi CPO).

columns.name: value
columns.description: Reported numeric physical volume or metric value.

columns.name: unit_id
columns.description: Measurement unit (e.g. metrik ton, ton, bbl, MT, barrels per day).

columns.name: lineage_page
columns.description: Source PDF page number in the original disclosure filing.

models.name: fx_rate
models.description: Daily foreign exchange (FX) rates and currency conversion benchmarks from Yahoo Finance (e.g. USD/IDR). Provides daily close, monthly average, and annual average rates to convert financial statement USD disclosures to IDR and evaluate cross-currency benchmarks.

columns.name: pair
columns.description: Currency pair symbol (e.g. 'USD/IDR').

columns.name: symbol
columns.description: Yahoo Finance market ticker (e.g. 'IDR=X').

columns.name: trade_date
columns.description: Trading and valuation date (YYYY-MM-DD).

columns.name: open
columns.description: Opening daily exchange rate.

columns.name: high
columns.description: Highest intra-day exchange rate.

columns.name: low
columns.description: Lowest intra-day exchange rate.

columns.name: rate_close
columns.description: Closing exchange rate for the day (e.g. Rupiah per 1 US Dollar, ~16,085 for Dec 2024, ~16,709 for Dec 2025).

columns.name: rate
columns.description: Benchmark closing spot exchange rate.

columns.name: base_currency
columns.description: Base currency code (e.g. 'USD').

columns.name: quote_currency
columns.description: Quote currency code (e.g. 'IDR').

columns.name: month_date
columns.description: First day of the calendar month (e.g. 2025-12-01).

columns.name: fiscal_year
columns.description: Calendar and fiscal year of the rate (e.g. 2024, 2025).

columns.name: monthly_avg_rate
columns.description: Monthly average exchange rate across all trading days in the month.

columns.name: yearly_avg_rate
columns.description: Annual average exchange rate across all trading days in the fiscal year (ideal for Income Statement and Cash Flow translations).
